title: Where the Tokens Go: open-science package (data, code and pre-registrations)
description:
Data, code and aggregate evidence behind the paper Where the Tokens Go: How Prompt Caching Shapes the Cost of an LLM Coding Agent (AGENT 2027 workshop at ICSE 2027, short paper, under review), with its pre-registrations. Personal and infrastructure details are redacted; every redaction is logged in REDACTION_LOG.md, and MANIFEST.json gives each file's sha256 and source.

Code is under the MIT licence (LICENSE) and data under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA).
